title: Toby the Turtle Who Wanted to Dance
description: A slow-moving turtle discovers his own unique rhythm for dancing under the moonlight.
character_reference: a tiny green turtle with a shiny polished shell and yellow polka-dot flippers

scenes.narration: Toby watched the forest animals spin and leap in the meadow, wishing he could dance like them. But his heavy green shell made him feel much too slow.
scenes.visual: medium shot of a small green turtle peeking out from under a polished shell while watching shadows of jumping animals nearby

scenes.narration: A wise old cricket hopped over and chirped, You do not need to leap high to dance, Toby. Just listen to the drumbeat of your own slow footsteps.
scenes.visual: close up of the turtle looking down thoughtfully while a tiny cricket sits on a blade of grass beside him

scenes.narration: Toby tapped one yellow-spotted flipper against the soft moss. Tap, slow tap, went his foot. It felt steady and calm, like the ticking of a grandfather clock.
scenes.visual: macro shot of a tiny turtle flipper tapping gently against green velvety moss in the moonlight

scenes.narration: He began to sway his shell from side to side in a slow, graceful waltz. The fireflies turned on their lights to make a glittering stage just for him.
scenes.visual: wide angle shot of the small turtle swaying gently on a patch of grass surrounded by floating golden firefly lights

scenes.narration: The rabbits and foxes stopped their fast bouncing and watched in wonder as Toby performed his beautiful, peaceful turtle dance under the silver moon.
scenes.visual: medium shot of the turtle moving gracefully in a circle while soft silver moonlight illuminates his shiny shell

scenes.narration: Toby tucked his head inside his shell with a happy grin, completely tired out from his wonderful performance. Dancing at your own pace is truly magical.
scenes.visual: close up of the turtle resting comfortably with his head tucked slightly inside his shiny green shell on soft moss

scenes.narration: There is no wrong way to dance your own unique song. Follow along for more bedtime stories every single day.
scenes.visual: peaceful moonlit forest clearing with soft silver beams shining down through quiet tree branches
